verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin framework installed into various agent harnesses (Claude Code, Devin, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.), not an agent itself, so an official MCP server is a plausible axis for this kind of product—but no evidence anywhere in the pack mentions Superpowers exposing an MCP server for agents to connect to; installation is via harness-specific plugin mechanisms, not MCP.
